text:
alerts-bot: [ALERT] high-error-rate: /v1/generate — firing 03:14:21 UTC (count=18 in 2m). Pager routed to @eng-sre. IncidentID=INC-20260315-87

omar: getting slammed with PD pages, looks like a noisy burst from a client-side retry pattern. lots of near-duplicates. Paging is >15 p/min.

leah: +1 seeing duplicate page churn. does the alert use request_id or client_id for the dedupe key?

rachel: rule uses route + status_code currently. many failures are 502 from upstream transient. same client_id across many requests.

samir: customer-impact check: overall error rate bump is ~1.8% for last 5m, but top 3 tenants see 7-12% failure. not widespread but noisy. will post quick graf.

rachel: pasted: https://grafana.internal/d/abc/alerts?from=now-10m to=now — top tenant t-47 has spike.

omar: can we do a quick mitigation: temporary PD rate-limit for this rule and change grouping to client_id?

leah: propose immediate actions: 1) enable temporary PD dedupe window (60s) on this alert, 2) change alert grouping key to client_id+route, 3) back off rule sensitivity (raise threshold to 10 errors/min for now). We'll follow with permanent fix.

elaine: support side: I'll reach out to top tenant ops to let them know we see retries and we're throttling alerts. want to avoid surprise.

samir: technical steps I'm doing now:
```bash
# mute PD for the alert for 30m (ops runbook):
/pager duty suppress INC-20260315-87 --duration 30m --reason "temporary dedupe during retry storm"
```

omar: doing on-call change: adding an ephemeral rate-limit on PD for this alert in the routing layer (will keep alerts in Slack but prevent PD flood).

leah: I'm opening a fast PR to modify the Prometheus rule: grouping_label -> client_id and raising for: to 3m. snippet below for the diffs.

leah: ```yaml
- alert: HighErrorRateGenerate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route) > 5
  for: 1m
+ # temp: group by client_id and bump threshold to reduce duplicate pages
+ alert: HighErrorRateGenerate
+ expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (client_id, route) > 10
+ for: 3m
```

rachel: LGTM for the short window change. we should also add a dedupe label in PD integration: grouping_key = {{ client_id }} to collapse identical pages.

samir: I've created a quick dashboard panel (link: https://grafana.internal/d/quick/pd-surge) showing dedupe rate, unique client counts, and PD pages/sec. sharing to ops.

elaine: copying tenant ops + starting a support DM. will update if they confirm massive retries.

omar: update: PD rate limit applied, dedupe window enabled. Slack alerting still active so we can see raw events.

leah: PR created: https://git.internal/repo/alerts/pulls/314 — description: temporary noise suppression for /v1/generate. tagging @eng-sre for fast review.

rachel: note for post-incident: schedule a follow-up to replace temporary threshold with smarter aggregator (prefix KV cache mismatch) and add a specific eval to detect retry loops.

samir: action items captured: [LEAH] finalize rule PR and revert after 6h review, [OMAR] confirm PD routing config and add grouping key, [RACHEL] build a persistent dashboard and assign to oncall owner, [ELAINE] confirm tenant ops outreach.

ops-bot: Action items logged in ops tracker: OTR-4421 (noise-mitigation), OTR-4422 (post-incident alert audit).

omar: closing the live-mitigation loop here — pages reduced from 18/m to ~2/m. leaving the temporary changes in place for 30m, will re-evaluate and then open long-term follow-up. :thumbsup:

rachel: will run a small retrospective note and propose alert rule templates to avoid route-only grouping.

elaine: thanks team — will ping once tenant confirms.

alerts-bot: Incident INC-20260315-87 status: mitigated (temporary suppressions applied). Follow-ups assigned.
